idea-plugin.name: EU Liability Window Lint
idea-plugin.description:
12 rules read your CHANGELOG.md the way Directive (EU) 2024/2853 will read it from 2026-12-09: undated releases lose the start of the 10-year window in Art. 17(2), and the AS-IS clause is void under Art. 15.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EU Liability Window Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/pld-liability-window-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/pld-liability-window-lint

action.text: EU Liability Window Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EU Liability Window Lint on the file in the editor
